wins: Completed reconnaissance sweep covering all initial hosts within time budget, generating comprehensive asset list.
Executed automated scanning modules without delays, maintaining high reward despite failure to achieve objective.
fails: Failed to pivot from initial foothold due to missing credentials and lack of credential harvesting routines.
Unable to exploit identified service because required exploit payloads were not delivered or configured.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase succeeded but exploitation and post-compromise maneuvers fizzled; need targeted credential harvesting and payload delivery experiments.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: No credential harvesting performed after initial access, preventing lateral movement and exploitation.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH service responds with banner
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration using nmap script ssh-auth-methods and sshv1

skill_cards.if_condition: When host yields credentials or token from scanner output
skill_cards.then_action: Store credential and attempt SSH login with hydra using found combinations
Deploy credential harvesting script to capture SSH keys and cached passwords

memory_ops.reason: Consistent early detection of SSH services enabled timely enumeration.
Credential pursuit after enumeration remains critical to break kill chain.

next_experiments.title: Credential Harvesting Post Enumeration
next_experiments.description: After SSH enumeration (skill_001), immediately run credential harvesting scripts (skill_003 + custom shell) to collect keys/passwords before attempting lateral movement.

next_experiments.title: Hydra-driven SSH Bruteforce with Validated Lists
next_experiments.description: Feed discovered usernames/passwords into hydra module (skill_002) targeting running SSH service, ensuring successful login before payload delivery.

next_experiments.title: Payload Delivery with SSH Session
next_experiments.description: Following successful SSH login, stage Meterpreter shell or custom payload via established session to regain command execution for exploitation phase.
